name: Advance_Global_Chat-Expansion
description:
[h1]Advance Global Chat - Comprehensive Chat Management System[/h1]

[h2]REQUIREMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*]DayZ Expansion Chat
[*]DayZ Expansion Core
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] This mod requires DayZ Expansion Chat Scripts to function. It will not work without the Expansion chat system.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]DESCRIPTION[/h2]

Advance Global Chat is a comprehensive chat management system for DayZ servers that provides advanced moderation tools, spam protection, and detailed logging capabilities.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]KEY FEATURES[/h2]

[b]Slow Mode Protection[/b]
Prevents chat spam by limiting the number of messages players can send within a configurable time window. Includes cooldown periods when limits are exceeded.

[b]Word Filtering System[/b]
[list]
[*]Warning Words: Automatically filter and replace inappropriate words
[*]Kick Words: Automatically kick players for severe violations
[*]Configurable ban durations for both warning and kick words
[*]Whole-word matching prevents false positives
[*]Permanent global chat ban system when violation thresholds are reached
[/list]

[b]English-Only Character Filtering[/b]
Restrict chat messages to English characters only. Blocks non-English characters including Cyrillic, Chinese, Arabic, and emojis.

[b]Temporary Chat Bans[/b]
Players who violate rules receive temporary bans from chat. Ban system persists across server restarts with complete ban history tracking.

[b]Admin Menu Interface[/b]
Full-featured admin menu accessible via keybind with the following tabs:
[list]
[*]Players: View online/banned players, reset player data, unban players
[*]SlowMode: Configure slow mode settings
[*]WordFilter: Configure word filtering and English-only settings
[*]Messages: Customize all system messages
[*]Logging: Enable/disable logging for different event types
[*]Admin: Manage admin list (add/remove admins by GUID)
[*]PvPPvE: Configure zone-based chat blocking (requires NinjinsPvPPvE mod)
[/list]

[b]Database Tracking[/b]
Tracks player violations with warning and kick counters. Stores complete ban history with timestamps, durations, and triggering words. Permanent global chat ban system when thresholds are reached.

[b]Comprehensive Logging[/b]
Consolidated logging system that logs all chat-related events to a single line per event for easy tracking and moderation.

[b]NinjinsPvPPvE Integration (Optional)[/b]
Conditional integration with NinjinsPvPPvE mod that allows disabling chat in specific zone types (PvP, PvE, Raid, Safe Zones). Works automatically when NinjinsPvPPvE is loaded, gracefully does nothing when it's not present.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]CONFIGURATION[/h2]

All settings can be configured through the admin menu UI or by editing JSON files:

[list]
[*][code]Advance_Chat_Settings.json[/code]: Main configuration file
[*][code]Advance_Chat_WordsFilters.json[/code]: Word filter definitions
[/list]

Configuration files are automatically created in: [code]$profile:Advance_Global_Chat/[/code]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]ADMIN FEATURES[/h2]

[list]
[*]Access admin menu via keybind
[*]View and manage online players
[*]View and manage banned players
[*]Reset player database data
[*]Unban players
[*]Configure almost all settings through UI
[*]Add/remove admins
[*]Reload configuration without server restart
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]TECHNICAL DETAILS[/h2]

[list]
[*]All player data persists across server restarts
[*]Ban system uses date-based timestamps for reliability
[*]Complete ban history maintained for auditing
[*]RPC-based client-server communication
[*]Modular design with AGC_ prefix to prevent conflicts
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]INSTALLATION[/h2]

[olist]
[*]Subscribe to this mod
[*]Add to server startup: [code]-mod=@Advance_Global_Chat[/code]
[*]Ensure DayZ Expansion Chat Scripts and Core Scripts are loaded
[*]Configuration files will be created automatically on first run
[*]Add your admin GUID to [code]Advance_Chat_Settings.json[/code] or via admin menu
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]SUPPORT[/h2]

For issues, feature requests, or questions, contact us.



[h2]CONTACT:[/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZzxGzdx3/discored.png[/img]

Ninjin: https://discord.gg/mEPT9KNSxs
Fubar88: https://discord.gg/FJa82GVfEa

name: HardlineItemSystem
description:
[h1]🔒 Hardline Item System - Reputation-Based Item Restrictions[/h1]

[b]Restrict items based on player reputation from DayZ Expansion Hardline.[/b] Create progression systems where players must earn reputation to unlock weapons and gear!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔥 Key Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] 🎯 [b]Reputation Restrictions[/b]: Items unlock as players gain reputation
[*] 📊 [b]Visual UI[/b]: Press [b]H[/b] for 3D previews and unlock status
[*] 🎨 [b]Color-Coded[/b]: Green = Unlocked, Red = Locked
[*] ⚡ [b]Real-Time Sync[/b]: Auto-sends data on player connect
[*] 🔄 [b]Auto-Sorting[/b]: Low to high reputation order
[*] 🛡️ [b]Server-Side[/b]: No client exploits possible
[*] ⚙️ [b]Hot-Reload[/b]: Edit JSON live, auto-reload every 60s
[*] ♾️ [b]Unlimited Levels[/b]: Create as many tiers as you want
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎮 How It Works[/h2]

[b]Players:[/b] Press H → View items → Green = unlocked, Red = locked → Earn reputation → Items unlock automatically!

[b]Admins:[/b] Edit JSON config → Server handles everything → Changes apply in 60 seconds.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📋 Requirements[/h2]

[b]REQUIRES DayZ Expansion Hardline![/b]

Install either:
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2116157322]DayZ Expansion Bundle[/url]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2572331199]DayZ Expansion Hardline[/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙️ Configuration[/h2]

Auto-generated at: [code]ServerProfile/HardlineItemSystem/HardlineConfig.json[/code]

[h3]Example:[/h3]
[code]{
    "HardlineItems": {
        "20": [
            "Glock19",
            "MakarovIJ70",
            "CZ75"
        ],
        "40": [
            "M4A1",
            "AKM",
            "MP5K"
        ],
        "60": [
            "FAL",
            "SVD",
            "VSS"
        ],
        "100": [
            "NVGoggles",
            "GhillieSuit_Woodland"
        ],
        "200": [
            "LAR",
            "M107"
        ],
        "400": [
            "ExpansionLAW",
            "ExpansionRPG7"
        ]
    }
}[/code]

[b]Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*] ♾️ Unlimited levels: any number works (10, 999, 50000...)
[*] 📦 Unlimited items per level
[*] 📝 Classnames are case-sensitive: "AKM" not "akm"
[*] 🔄 Auto-reload every 60 seconds
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💡 Tips[/h2]

✅ Use progression: 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000
✅ Mix all item types: weapons, gear, tools, vehicles
✅ Works with ANY mod items
✅ Server auto-reloads - no restart needed

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎯 Example Systems[/h2]

[b]Casual:[/b]
[code]"10": Pistols
"50": Rifles  
"100": Snipers
"200": End-game[/code]

[b]Hardcore:[/b]
[code]"500": Pistols
"1000": Rifles
"5000": Snipers[/code]

[b]Balanced:[/b]
[code]"0": Starting gear
"50": Tier 1
"150": Tier 2
"500": Military

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎨 Controls[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]H[/b] = Open/close
[*] [b]X button[/b] = Close
[*] [b]Scroll[/b] = Browse items
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎯 Use Cases[/h2]

[list]
[*] 🏆 Progression servers
[*] ⚔️ PvP balance
[*] 🎮 RPG-style servers
[*] 🏅 Reward systems
[*] 🌍 Long-term engagement
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔧 Managing Reputation[/h2]

Players earn reputation via:
[list]

[*] Killing players
[*] Killing animals

[/list]

name: GRESHNIK TRADER
description:
[h1]TraderGreshnik - NPC Trader System[/h1]

[h2]EXPERIMENTAL VERSION[/h2]

A simple and lightweight NPC trader system for DayZ with minimalist design, basic trading functionality, banking system, and JSON configuration.

[url=https://discord.gg/2Wn597DRYw][img]https://i.imgur.com/yGZtB0v.png[/img][/url]

[b]Join Discord for support:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/2Wn597DRYw]https://discord.gg/2Wn597DRYw[/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Key Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]NPC Traders[/b] - Any DayZ survivor model with customizable clothing and positioning
[*] [b]Trading System[/b] - Buy/sell items with markup/markdown and condition multipliers
[*] [b]Multiple Currencies[/b] - Use any DayZ item as currency (ammo, gold, custom items)
[*] [b]Bank System[/b] - Deposit/withdraw currency with transaction fees and daily limits
[*] [b]Moving Traders[/b] - Up to 3 movement positions with cyclic rotation
[*] [b]Faction Integration[/b] - Restrict traders to specific PDALITE factions
[*] [b]Admin Discounts[/b] - Configurable discounts by SteamID64
[*] [b]Purchase Limits[/b] - Per-day limits and cooldowns on items
[*] [b]In-Game Editor[/b] - Press J to open admin trader editor
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Trading System[/h2]

[b]Buy & Sell Items[/b]
Players can buy and sell items from NPC traders with configurable markups and markdowns.

[b]Condition Multipliers[/b]
Item prices adjust based on condition:
[list]
[*] Pristine: 100%
[*] Worn: 85%
[*] Damaged: 65%
[*] Badly Damaged: 40%
[*] Ruined: 0%
[/list]

[b]Currency Example:[/b]
[code]
{
  "Currencies": [
    { "ItemClass": "Ammo_9x19", "Value": 1 },
    { "ItemClass": "Ammo_762x39", "Value": 3 },
    { "ItemClass": "GoldBar", "Value": 1000 }
  ]
}
[/code]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Trader Editor (J Key)[/h2]

[b]ADMIN ACCESS ONLY![/b]

Press [b]J[/b] to open the trader editor. Only players listed in [b]AdminDiscounts.json[/b] have access.

[b]Editor Tabs:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Traders[/b] - View, edit, delete, teleport to traders
[*] [b]Create[/b] - Create new traders with full configuration
[*] [b]Items Config[/b] - Manage trader inventory and prices
[*] [b]Economy[/b] - Configure currency and condition multipliers
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Configuration Files[/h2]

Location: [b]profiles/GreshnikTrader/[/b]

[code]
profiles/GreshnikTrader/
    NPC/
        {traderID}.json        # NPC configuration
    Item/
        {traderID}.json        # Trader items
    AdminDiscounts.json        # Admin access & discounts
[/code]

[b]AdminDiscounts.json Example:[/b]
[code]
{
  "AdminDiscounts": [
    {
      "SteamID64": "76561198012345678",
      "DiscountBuyPercent": 50,
      "DiscountSellPercent": 25,
      "Comment": "Admin Name"
    }
  ]
}
[/code]

[b]NPC Configuration Example:[/b]
[code]
{
  "ID": "trader1",
  "ClassName": "SurvivorM_Peter",
  "Position": "4615.02 76.15 1811.94",
  "Categories": ["Weapons", "Food", "Medical"],
  "Name": "Gunsmith",
  "Currencies": [
    { "ItemClass": "Ammo_9x19", "Value": 1 }
  ],
  "BuyMarkup": 15,
  "SellMarkdown": 30,
  "AllowedGroups": [],
  "MoveEnabled": false
}
[/code]

[b]Item Configuration Example:[/b]
[code]
{
  "Categories": {
    "Weapons": [
      {
        "Category": "Weapons",
        "ItemClass": "AK74",
        "Stock": 10,
        "BuyPrice": 5000,
        "SellPrice": 2500,
        "MaxPerDay": 2,
        "CooldownSeconds": 3600
      }
    ]
  }
}
[/code]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Faction Restriction (PDALITE)[/h2]

Restrict trader access to specific factions:

[code]
{
  "AllowedGroups": ["Svoboda", "Military"]
}
[/code]

[b]Available Factions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Svoboda
[*] Monolit
[*] Bandits
[*] Military
[*] Killers
[/list]

Empty array [] = available to all players

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Installation[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Subscribe to mod on Workshop
[*] Add to server launch parameters: [b]-mod=@CF;@TraderGreshnik;@Greshnik_PDALITE[/b]
[*] Configure [b]profiles/GreshnikTrader/AdminDiscounts.json[/b]
[*] Press [b]J[/b] in-game to create traders (admin only)
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]DayZ Standalone 1.25+[/b]
[*] [b]Community Framework (CF)[/b]
[*] [b]Greshnik_PDALITE[/b] (optional, for faction features)
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Hotkeys[/h2]

[b]J[/b] - Open trader editor (admin only)

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

This is an experimental version. Planned features:
[list]
[*] Auto-import economy from TraderPlus
[*] Expansion integration (if possible)
[*] UI/UX improvements
[*] Performance optimization
[/list]

[h2]LICENSE & REPACKAGING[/h2]

[b]REPACKAGING WITHOUT PERMISSION IS STRICTLY PROHIBITED![/b]

Want to repackage this mod? Contact me via Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/2Wn597DRYw][b]Join Discord: https://discord.gg/2Wn597DRYw[/b][/url]

After receiving permission, you will be granted a special role and LITE version license.

For repackaging permissions, feature requests, or any questions - join the Discord server above!

[b]Greshnik[/b]

All rights reserved.

name: DevCA King of the Hill
description:
[h1]👑 DevCA KOTH 👑
King of the Hill Events System[/h1]
[b][i]The ultimate competitive PvP event system for your DayZ server.[/i][/b]

[hr][/hr]

[b]Want to create epic battles and intense competition on your server?
Tired of players wandering aimlessly with no clear objectives?[/b]

DevCA KOTH brings dynamic, competitive events that keep players engaged and fighting for valuable rewards.
This plug-and-play mod implements a complete King of the Hill system with persistence,
smart rewards, and full Discord integration to create unforgettable server experiences.

[quote=Experience the thrill of conquest!]
✅ [b]DYNAMIC EVENTS:[/b] Automatic zone-based events spawn across the map, creating natural PvP hotspots and intense battles for control.

✅ [b]SMART REWARDS:[/b] Winners receive locked vehicles, containers, or custom loot sets. Rewards are indestructible until the event ends, ensuring fair distribution.

✅ [b]PERSISTENCE SYSTEM:[/b] Events survive server restarts and crashes. The system automatically resumes from where it left off, never losing progress.

✅ [b]OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE:[/b] Advanced caching and optimized timers ensure smooth gameplay even with multiple active events. No lag, no FPS drops.
[/quote]

[h2]⚡ Performance & Features v2.0[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dramatically reduced server load:[/b] Optimized event timers, player caching, and distance calculations using efficient algorithms. Events update every 2 seconds instead of 1, reducing CPU usage by up to 50%.

[*] [b]Smooth gameplay:[/b] Smart player synchronization cache updates every 5 seconds, eliminating frequent GetPlayers() calls that cause lag spikes.

[*] [b]Intelligent distance calculations:[/b] Uses DistanceSq instead of Distance for all comparisons, avoiding expensive square root operations and improving performance by 30%.

[*] [b]Event persistence:[/b] Complete state saving system ensures events continue after restarts. Progress, rewards, and player data are automatically preserved.

[*] [b]Automatic config reload:[/b] Configuration files are automatically reloaded at configurable intervals (Config_ReloadInterval_minutes, default: 10 minutes), making server management effortless and downtime-free.

[*] [b]Zero dependencies:[/b] Works perfectly standalone or with optional map mods (BasicMap, LBmaster, Expansion, VPP). Full compatibility with all popular DayZ mods.
[/list]

[quote=💥 Major Features - v2.0 💥]
We've completely redesigned the KOTH system for maximum performance and reliability. This update brings:

• [b]Advanced reward system:[/b] Spawn vehicles (cars, helicopters, boats) or large containers as rewards. All rewards are locked and indestructible until the event completes, preventing griefing and ensuring fair play.

• [b]Complete persistence:[/b] Events automatically save every 30 seconds and restore on server start. Never lose event progress, even during crashes or unexpected restarts.

• [b]Discord webhooks:[/b] Full integration with Discord for event announcements, player participation tracking, winner notifications, and statistics. Keep your community informed in real-time.

• [b]Enhanced loot system:[/b] Advanced loot configuration with alternatives, attachments, extra items, spawn chances, and automatic magazine/battery spawning for energy items.

• [b]Safety checks:[/b] Automatic validation before starting events (server FPS, minimum players, player proximity) ensures events only spawn when conditions are optimal.

• [b]Statistics tracking:[/b] Complete player and server statistics system tracks wins, participation, fatalities, and more. Perfect for leaderboards and community engagement.

💬 [b]Your feedback matters![/b]
Please share your impressions, bug reports, and suggestions on our Discord so we can keep improving together.
[/quote]

[h2]🔥 Main Features 🔥[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Automatic Event System:[/b] Events spawn automatically based on configurable timers and player count. No manual intervention needed.

[*] [b]Zone-Based Capture:[/b] Players must stay within the capture zone to progress. Multiple players speed up capture, but competition is fierce!

[*] [b]Flexible Rewards:[/b] Configure rewards per zone or globally. Choose from vehicles (cars, helicopters, boats), large containers, or custom loot sets with advanced configuration.

[*] [b]Full Map Integration:[/b] Works seamlessly with popular map mods:
[list]
[*] [b]BasicMap[/b]
[*] [b]LBmaster Groups[/b]
[*] [b]Expansion Navigation[/b]
[*] [b]VanillaPPMap[/b] ✨
[/list]

[*] [b]Plug-and-Play Installation:[/b] Just load the mod. No complex setup or mission script edits required. Everything is configured through simple JSON files.

[*] [b]Detailed Logs & Webhooks:[/b] Server owners can track all events (start, progress, wins, failures) through local logs and Discord notifications with rich embeds.

[*] [b]Flexible Configuration:[/b] Enable or disable features, adjust timers, configure zones, set rewards through well-documented JSON files with automatic migration and backup systems.
[/list]

[h2]🔧 Installation & Usage 🔧[/h2]
[b]For Server Admins:[/b]
[list=1]
[*] [b]Install the mod[/b] and configure zones, rewards, and settings in the JSON files located at [b]$profile:DevCARLOS/DevCA_Koth/[/b]
[*] [b]Set up Discord webhooks[/b] by adding your webhook URL in KingOfTheHill_*.json for event notifications and ranking updates
[*] [b]Automatic config reload[/b] - Configuration files are automatically reloaded at the interval set in Config_ReloadInterval_minutes (default: 10 minutes) - no restart needed!
[*] [b]Monitor events[/b] through logs and Discord notifications
[/list]

[b]For Players:[/b]
[list=1]
[*] [b]Wait for event announcement[/b] - notifications will appear when a KOTH event starts
[*] [b]Rush to the zone[/b] and stay within the capture radius to progress the event
[*] [b]Fight for control[/b] - the more players in zone, the faster it captures, but competition is intense!
[*] [b]Win the event[/b] to unlock exclusive rewards - vehicles, containers, or custom loot sets
[/list]

[h2]📢 Further Info[/h2]

🚫 [b]No repacks allowed.[/b] Don't ask — repacking [b]poisons the community[/b] and destroys the spirit of collaboration that keeps DayZ alive.
You are free to look into the mod for [b]learning purposes[/b] or to understand how it works.
I kindly ask for respect for the effort invested: if you reuse parts or ideas from the code, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dayzserverturorial/][b]credit
 the author (DevCARLOS / DevCarlos)[/b][/url] in your modifications or repositories.
This project represents many hours of development, testing, and community support — attribution helps keep the cycle of improvements running for everyone.
